headline_metric: micro typed F1 over unique normalized value/canonical-label pairs per row
normalization: strip Python ASCII string.punctuation and whitespace from both edges; case-sensitive
failures: empty predictions; gold retained in denominator; no automatic retries
leak_rate: unique gold values not contained in any grounded predicted value; ignore label
latency: client elapsed for all recorded attempts; p50 median and nearest-rank p95
cost: reported token usage and dated standard rates; missing usage means unknown, never zero
strict_raw_label_f1: unavailable because frozen gold already merged numbered labels
small_support_warning: CARDISSUER has only one gold instance
